title: Infant fever dehydration and breathing red flags
category: Medical and first · Aid · Disaster · Health
summary: Medical-heavy survival entry for watching feeding, diapers, temperature, breathing effort, and behavior in infants.
warnings: Escalate urgently if you see: young infant fever, poor feeding, few wet diapers, blue lips, chest pulling, limpness, or persistent crying.
failure_signs: Red flags appear: young infant fever, poor feeding, few wet diapers, blue lips, chest pulling, limpness, or persistent crying

title: Elder delirium fall and dehydration watch
category: Medical and first · Aid · Disaster · Health
summary: Medical-heavy survival entry for checking sudden confusion, fluids, medicines, mobility, and safe toileting.
warnings: Escalate urgently if you see: new confusion, fall, fever, not drinking, missed medicines, weakness, or unsafe wandering.
failure_signs: Red flags appear: new confusion, fall, fever, not drinking, missed medicines, weakness, or unsafe wandering

title: Disability medical handover sheet
category: Medical and first · Aid · Disaster · Health
summary: Medical-heavy survival entry for documenting communication needs, mobility supports, medicines, devices, routines, and helpers.
warnings: Escalate urgently if you see: evacuation, caregiver absent, device broken, sensory overload, lost medicine, or inaccessible shelter.
failure_signs: Red flags appear: evacuation, caregiver absent, device broken, sensory overload, lost medicine, or inaccessible shelter
